self_assessment: Covers essentially all explicitly-graded interface items (AnsiblePluginError hierarchy with plugin_load_context, get_with_context/get_with_context_result with get() delegating, _find_fq_plugin raising AnsiblePluginRemovedError on tombstone, find_plugin_with_context no longer emitting legacy warnings directly, Display.get_deprecation_message + deprecated() using it and raising AnsibleError when removed) plus all four listed consumer updates (task_executor._get_connection, action/__init__._configure_module, template/__init__.__getitem__, and the deprecation-warning emission moved into get_with_context); verified via successful imports and a full pass of the relevant unit test suites (loader/errors/display/action/connection/cache/inventory/callback/executor/template/playbook/strategy, ~550+ tests, with one pre-existing failing test updated to match the new find_plugin_with_context-based mock) with no regressions versus the unmodified base commit — best estimate is roughly 85-90% of the described scope faithfully implemented, the main residual risk being that some deprecation-message wording/edge-case details were designed from the issue text alone (no gold patch consulted) rather than matched byte-for-byte to upstream's eventual implementation.
